title: Held-out-person fNIRS optical-density classification
current_best_explanation: No current global winner has been verified on this exact frozen input, split and scorer. A published dataset name or broad leaderboard lead is insufficient.
executed_endpoint: FRESH motor dataset, people 1–7 train/8–10 test; left/right 2-second tapping sessions; 136 optical-density measurements × eight delayed 1-second bins, baseline-relative 3–11 s. Balanced accuracy. No chromophore conversion or spatial metadata in the model interface.

existing_reference.name: Delayed-channel-mean optical-density shrinkage LDA
existing_reference.evidence: A: executed conventional baseline, not a current specialist.
existing_reference.strength: Uses exactly the supplied signals and no invented optical parameters.
problems: Separate left/right sessions confound condition with recording.
No short-channel regression, Beer–Lambert conversion, motion repair or channel-quality optimization.
Binning discards much raw temporal structure.
existing_reference.verification_scope: Only the named locally audited reference/archived outputs, not every newer candidate or equal-budget/global optimality.

candidates.name: MtReNIRS
candidates.information_match: Not drop-in: chromophore-aware representations and montage identity cannot be reconstructed from the anonymous OD-bin interface.

candidates.name: 67-dataset fNIRS corpus/dataloaders
candidates.evidence: C: 29 October 2026 primary resource, not a trained-model leaderboard.
candidates.information_match: Useful for a future raw HbO/HbR/montage track; not evidence of a best FRESH classifier.

candidates.name: Training-only regularized OD temporal decoder / SVM
candidates.evidence: C: scientifically compatible proposed conventional comparison; no invented published FRESH score.
candidates.information_match: Retains all eight bins, subject-grouped validation, same inputs and targets.

recommended_next_comparator: A fixed small regularized logistic/SVM/temporal-feature panel selected on training people only; maintain OD semantics. A separate raw fNIRS track is needed for MtReNIRS.
switching_assessment: ADD a stronger same-information conventional panel, Tier C. Do not silently switch the endpoint to HbO/HbR foundation modeling. The newest foundations are relevant field developments but currently unmatched.
limitations: FRESH reproducibility outcomes concern scientific analyses, not this classification metric.
New preprints are days old; executable checkpoints and independent replication are not verified.
Chromophore/geometry recovery would change the supplied input information.

evidence_tiers.B: Primary method/benchmark with relevant task evidence but an unmatched split, inputs, scorer or budget.
evidence_tiers.C: Author repository, preprint, mathematical proposal or adaptation requiring additional validation.
evidence_tiers.D: Unresolved access, unavailable artifacts or input mismatch precludes an executable recommendation.

execution_policy: Literature review only. No inference, fitting, new scores, checkpoint downloads, frozen protocol edits or result changes. Any new comparator requires a prospective amendment, frozen training-only selection and separate result records.
score_import_policy: No unmatched published numbers were imported into benchmark scores.
